arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && cat > edge.py <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extra edge cases: restore-first-checkpoint, chained restores, etc."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fuzz as F

def full_run(cfg, ops):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p, err = F.compile_prog(cfg, d)
        assert p, err
        rc, out, e = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], F.lines_of(ops).encode())
        assert rc == 0, (rc, e[:300])
        return [json.loads(l) for l in out.decode().splitlines()]

def split_run(cfg, ops, cut):
    """Run ops[:cut], checkpoint, then restore + ops[cut:] in a fresh process."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p, err = F.compile_prog(cfg, d)
        assert p, err
        rc, out, e = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], F.lines_of(ops[:cut]).encode())
        assert rc == 0, (rc, e[:300])
        lines = out.decode().splitlines()
        snap = json.loads(lines[-1])["checkpoint"]
        tail = '{"op":"restore","checkpoint":' + json.dumps(snap) + "}\n" + F.lines_of(ops[cut:])
        rc2, out2, e2 = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], tail.encode())
        assert rc2 == 0, (rc2, e2[:300])
        return [json.loads(l) for l in out2.decode().splitlines()], snap

cfg = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":3,"packet_limit":4,"prefix_width":3,
       "rules":[{"id":5,"class":1,"priority":2,"ranges":[[7,9],[1,3]]},
                {"id":2,"class":4,"priority":2,"ranges":[[1,3]]}],
       "fallback":{"feature":1,"threshold":-5,"le":{"class":11},"gt":{"class":12}}}

fails = 0
# checkpoint as the very first request
ops = [{"op":"checkpoint"},
       {"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},
       {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":8}]},
       {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":2,"source":1,"length":2}]},
       {"op":"close","flow":1,"time":9}]
whole = full_run(cfg, ops)
part, snap = split_run(cfg, ops[:1], 1)
if part[0] != {"events":[]} or part[1:] != whole[1:]:
    print("FAIL first-checkpoint restore"); fails += 1
else:
    print("OK first-checkpoint restore; snap =", json.dumps(snap))

# three checkpoints, restore from the middle one
ops = [{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},
       {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":8}]},
       {"op":"checkpoint"},
       {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":2,"source":1,"length":2}]},
       {"op":"checkpoint"},
       {"op":"open","flow":2,"time":5},
       {"op":"tick","time":100},
       {"op":"checkpoint"},
       {"op":"close","flow":1,"time":101},
       {"op":"close","flow":2,"time":102}]
whole = full_run(cfg, ops)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p, _ = F.compile_prog(cfg, d)
    rc, out, e = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], F.lines_of(ops).encode())
    lines = out.decode().splitlines()
    snaps = [json.loads(l)["checkpoint"] for l in lines if l.startswith('{"checkpoint"')]
    for i, snap in enumerate(snaps):
        cut = [j for j, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('{"checkpoint"')][i] + 1
        tail = '{"op":"restore","checkpoint":' + json.dumps(snap) + "}\n" + F.lines_of(ops[cut:])
        rc2, out2, e2 = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], tail.encode())
        got = [json.loads(l) for l in out2.decode().splitlines()]
        exp = [{"events":[]}] + [json.loads(l) for l in lines[cut:]]
        if rc2 != 0 or got != exp:
            print("FAIL restore from checkpoint %d" % i)
            for a, b in zip(got, exp):
                if a != b: print("   got", a, "\n   exp", b); break
            fails += 1
        else:
            print("OK restore from checkpoint %d" % i)

# restore then checkpoint again then restore
ops = [{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},
       {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":8}]},
       {"op":"checkpoint"},
       {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":4,"source":1,"length":2}]},
       {"op":"checkpoint"},
       {"op":"close","flow":1,"time":50}]
whole = full_run(cfg, ops)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p, _ = F.compile_prog(cfg, d)
    rc, out, e = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], F.lines_of(ops[:3]).encode())
    lines = out.decode().splitlines()
    snap1 = json.loads(lines[-1])["checkpoint"]
    tail = '{"op":"restore","checkpoint":' + json.dumps(snap1) + "}\n" + F.lines_of(ops[3:])
    rc2, out2, e2 = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], tail.encode())
    got = [json.loads(l) for l in out2.decode().splitlines()]
    exp = [{"events":[]}] + whole[3:]
    if rc2 != 0 or got != exp:
        print("FAIL chained restore"); fails += 1
        for a,b in zip(got,exp):
            if a!=b: print("  got",a,"\n  exp",b); break
    else:
        print("OK chained restore")

# zero-rule config with checkpoint/restore
cfg0 = {"version":1,"idle_timeout":2,"packet_limit":3,"prefix_width":2,"rules":[],
        "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}
ops = [{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0},
       {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":0,"time":1,"source":1,"length":5}]},
       {"op":"checkpoint"},
       {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":0,"time":2,"source":0,"length":5}]},
       {"op":"tick","time":9},
       {"op":"close","flow":0,"time":10}]
whole = full_run(cfg0, ops)
part, snap = split_run(cfg0, ops, 3)
exp = [{"events":[]}] + whole[3:]
if part != exp:
    print("FAIL zero-rule restore"); fails += 1
    for a,b in zip(part,exp):
        if a!=b: print("  got",a,"\n  exp",b); break
else:
    print("OK zero-rule restore")

print("failures:", fails)
PYEOF
python3 edge.py 2>&1 | grep -v "^done"
